Game Overview

At its heart, Space War is a arcade game about command your spaceship through intense battles in Space War, where traditional shooting meets groundbreaking voice-controlled combat. Use your voice to unleash powerful attacks and navigate challenging enemy waves. This dynamic experience adapts to both desktop and mobile play, offering intergalactic excitement at your fingertips.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Space War is easy to pick up. Command your spaceship through intense battles in Space War, where traditional shooting meets groundbreaking voice-controlled combat.
